summary.zh: 统计文本行数/字数/词数与编码，批量去重、排序与空行清理，以及多文本文件顺序合并。
summary.en: Line/word/encoding statistics, deduplication & sorting cleanup, and sequential text file merging.

summary.zh: CSV / TSV 互转 JSON 对象数组、Markdown 表格与 Excel 兼容的 UTF-8 BOM CSV，以及 JSON 数组导出为 CSV。
summary.en: Convert CSV/TSV to JSON arrays, Markdown tables, or Excel UTF-8 BOM CSV, and export JSON arrays to CSV.

summary.zh: 一键生成 Unicode / ASCII / Markdown 目录结构树并写入剪贴板，或导出含体积、时间与 SHA-256 的文件清单。
summary.en: Generate Unicode/ASCII/Markdown directory trees to clipboard and export CSV/JSON file manifests with optional SHA-256.

summary.zh: 批量同步创建/修改时间、按小时偏移修正时区差或从文件名自动解析日期，支持提交前逐项预览。
summary.en: Batch sync creation/modified timestamps, apply hour offsets, or extract dates from filenames with pre-commit preview.

summary.zh: Windows 原生 PowerShell 免编译插件：文件编码为 Base64 / Data URI 写入剪贴板，或从 Base64 文本还原为文件。
summary.en: Zero-compile Windows PowerShell plugin to encode files as Base64/Data URIs to clipboard or decode Base64 text back to files.

summary.zh: 修复旧 ZIP / FTP / GBK 环境造成的乱码文件名（cp437、latin-1 误解码），先预览再改名，冲突自动跳过。
summary.en: Repair mojibake file names from legacy ZIP/FTP archives mis-decoded as cp437 or latin-1, with preview and conflict skipping.

summary.zh: 批量美化、压缩、校验 JSON 或按键名递归排序，写回前预览，可保留 .bak 并保留原有 BOM 与换行风格。
summary.en: Batch pretty-print, minify, validate or recursively key-sort JSON with preview, backups, BOM and line-ending preservation.

summary.zh: 跨文件批量查找替换，支持正则、递归子目录与 UTF-8/GBK 自动探测，预览命中数后写回并保留 .bak。
summary.en: Cross-file find & replace with regex, recursion and UTF-8/GBK detection, previewing hit counts before writing with .bak backups.

summary.zh: 把图片压到指定体积（100KB/200KB/500KB/1MB/2MB 或自定义），先降质量再缩尺寸，报名上传一次过。
summary.en: Squeeze images to a target file size by lowering JPEG quality first and downscaling only when needed.

summary.zh: 竖向/横向长图与九宫格、四宫格拼接，等比留白不裁切，适合聊天记录与朋友圈。
summary.en: Combine photos into vertical or horizontal strips, 3x3 or 2x2 grids with letterboxing and no cropping.

summary.zh: 批量打文字水印：四角、居中或斜向平铺，字号自适应，不透明度与颜色可调。
summary.en: Batch text watermarks in any corner, centered or tiled diagonally, with adaptive font size and opacity.

summary.zh: 一寸/二寸/小一寸/大一寸标准证件照裁切，居中裁切或完整留白，输出可直接上传。
summary.en: Crop photos into standard ID sizes (1-inch, 2-inch, small/large) with center-crop or padded modes.

summary.zh: 感知哈希找相似照片（连拍、转发压缩、改过尺寸都能认出），每组保留最清晰的一张。
summary.en: Find near-duplicate photos with perceptual hashing (burst shots, re-compressed, resized) and keep the sharpest.

summary.zh: 手机照片按拍摄日期重命名、分年/月归档，HEIC/WebP/TIFF 转 JPG，可选压缩，预览后移动。
summary.en: Rename phone photos by capture date, archive into year/month folders, convert HEIC/WebP/TIFF to JPEG.

plugins.name: 清理垃圾文件与空文件夹
plugins.author: RightToolbox Community

summary.zh: 清理 Thumbs.db、.DS_Store、临时文件与空文件夹，先列清单确认再删除，跳过符号链接。
summary.en: Remove Thumbs.db, .DS_Store, temp files and empty folders with a preview step and reparse-point safety.

summary.zh: 按 EXIF 自动把手机照片转正，或手动旋转 90°/180°、左右上下镜像；方向正确的图不产生多余副本。
summary.en: Fix photo orientation from EXIF automatically, or rotate/mirror manually; correct photos get no duplicate.

summary.zh: 批量加白边、拍立得边框、细黑边或圆角（透明背景），宽度按长边百分比自适应。
summary.en: Batch add white borders, polaroid frames, thin outlines or rounded transparent corners with adaptive width.

summary.zh: 把网址、文字或 WiFi 信息生成 PNG 二维码，可选尺寸、纠错级别与颜色，直接存到当前文件夹。
summary.en: Turn URLs, text or WiFi credentials into a PNG QR code with configurable size, error correction and colour.

plugins.name: PDF 合并 / 拆分 / 提取
plugins.author: RightToolbox Community

summary.zh: 多个 PDF 合并成一个、按页拆成单页，或按 1-3,5 提取指定页码；发票、合同、扫描件一次整理好。
summary.en: Merge PDFs, split every page into its own file, or extract ranges like 1-3,5 without re-compressing content.
